title: Report a problem
none: You have not sent any reports.
saved: Anonymous reports saved on this device

category.physical_hazard: Physical hazard: something could hurt someone

urgent: If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 now.

mode.label: How should we handle your name?

identified.title: Named
identified.privacy: Your name is shared with the investigator and may be shared with management to fix the problem.

confidential.title: Confidential
confidential.privacy: Only the investigator sees your name. Your supervisor and payroll team cannot see this report.

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.privacy: FairShift does not store who sent this report. Limits: details you write (where, when, who) can still identify you, especially in small teams. You cannot add files or use voice in this mode. Keep your tracking code safe; it cannot be recovered.

descriptionHelp: Write at least 10 characters. If you chose Anonymous, leave out details that could identify you.
attachmentsHelp: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 10 MB each.
attachmentsOff: Files cannot be added to anonymous reports, so nothing can link the report back to you.

done.title: Report sent
done.trackingWarn: This code is shown only once. Write it down or copy it. It cannot be recovered.
done.saveOnDevice: Save on this device (do not use on a shared phone)
done.namedNote: You can follow this report under My reports.

errors.chooseMode: Please choose how we should handle your name.
errors.fileType: That file type is not allowed. Use PDF, JPEG, PNG or WEBP.
errors.fileSize: That file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.uploadFailed: Your report was sent, but a file could not be added.

case.title: Your report
case.actions: What would you like to do?
case.reopenNote: Tell us why you are reopening (at least 10 characters).
case.escalateInfo: If you want to take this further, you can contact your state labour department, a registered trade union, or a legal aid service. If someone is in immediate danger, call 112.

track.title: Check an anonymous report
track.intro: Enter the reference code and the tracking code you saved when you sent your report.
track.notFound: We could not find a report with that reference and code.
track.noUpdates: No updates yet. Please check again later.
